title: The 6 Best Wood Lathe 2026
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for wood lathe 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at wood lathe 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: JET 12-Inch x 21-Inch Variable-Speed Woodworking Lathe (JWL-1221VS)
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch swing, Variable speed 60-3600 RPM, Indexing.
strengths: Cast iron construction significantly reduces vibration compared to WEN
12-inch swing for larger bowls than the WEN 3421
Variable speed from 60 RPM (sanding) to 3,600 RPM (pen turning)
Indexing wheel for equally-spaced fluting and decorative work
limitations: Higher price than WEN entry models
Still not the swing capacity for large hollow-form turning

products.name: NOVA 46300 Comet II Variable Speed Mini Lathe 12-Inch x 16.5-Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: Mini lathe, Variable speed, 10-inch swing.
strengths: Nova is New Zealand's premium lathe brand -- higher quality than WEN at the mini price point
Variable speed with consistent power at low RPM -- correct for starting large, unbalanced blanks
Compact footprint for small shops
The correct mini lathe for pen turning, small bowls, and tool handles
limitations: Mini form factor limits the size of work
Higher price than WEN for similar capacity

products.name: Delta Industrial 46-460 12-1/2-Inch Variable-Speed MIDI Lathe
products.blurb: Key specs: 12.5-inch swing, Variable speed, Outboard turning.
strengths: Outboard turning capability for bowls larger than the swing would normally allow
Cast iron headstock and tailstock for reduced vibration
12.5-inch swing handles large production bowls
Delta brand history and parts availability
limitations: Delta quality has been inconsistent since the brand's manufacturing moved
Less community support than Jet or Nova

products.name: Laguna Tools Revo Lathe 220v 2HP 18-Inch/36-Inch (MLAREVO 1836)
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-inch swing, Sliding headstock, 3 HP.
strengths: Sliding headstock moves along the bed -- the headstock turns bowl-side outboard without moving the piece
15-inch swing at a price significantly below Powermatic
3 HP motor with constant speed control
The most popular upgrade lathe for woodturners moving from entry models

products.name: PSI Woodworking KWL-1018VS Turncrafter Commander 10-Inch Variable Speed Midi Lathe
products.blurb: Key specs: 3/4 HP motor, 10-inch swing, Variable speed, two belt positions.
strengths: PSI Woodworking is a long-established midi lathe brand with a strong woodturning-community following
Two belt positions (500-2,000 RPM and 1,500-3,600 RPM) give a wide practical speed range
The correct step-up lathe for turners who have outgrown a mini lathe but don't need full-size swing
Good quality construction at a mid-range price
limitations: Less brand recognition than Jet or Nova in general retail
Fewer accessory options than the larger Jet or Nova ecosystems

products.name: RIKON Power Tools 70-105 10-Inch x 18-Inch 1/2 HP Mini Lathe
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 speed, 10-inch swing, Budget price.
strengths: Lowest price functional lathe from a recognized brand
5 speed selection covers pen turning to small bowls
Rikon has a good reputation for value tools in the woodworking community
limitations: Belt-driven speed changes require stopping to change belts
Lighter construction than variable speed models
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
